page.content:
Anton Periwig, known as Tsuruoka (鶴岡 Tsuruoka) in the Japanese version, is a character in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters. He is the game's incarnation of Tsuruoka from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

page.overview:
Who is Anton Periwig?

Anton Periwig, known as Tsuruoka (鶴岡 Tsuruoka) in the Japanese version, is a character in the video game, Yu-Gi-Oh! Dungeon Dice Monsters. He is the game's incarnation of Tsuruoka from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

Periwig's Crest Pool contains Beast and Warrior monsters.
